product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.summary: The slim desktop PCS30 with a 40 MHz 386DX.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.history: Olivetti included the PCS30 DX/40 in the PCS30–PCS40 line of 386 and 486 systems. It documented this model as a slim desktop configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.architecture: Video and storage used expansion cards. With the standard cards installed, 3 of the 5 AT slots remained free in the standard configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.firmware: The board determines which BIOS to look for. The guide documents Harward for 4386-VC-HD.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs30-dx40.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §39, pp. 39-1–39-3.
